proof: The launcher exports PYTHONPATH as release_root:owned_model_source but does not change to a controlled working directory or enable Python safe-path mode.
For -m execution, the inherited working-directory entry remains sys.path[0] ahead of the owned model source at sys.path[2].
model_checks.construct_model promotes config.staged_root only when it is absent; the launcher has already placed it in sys.path, so it is not promoted.

With the preserved mutable original root as the inherited CWD, the exact runtime ordering resolves models/__init__.py and models/birwkv7_diffusion.py from qz_stage_traj4096_v7 rather than v3/model_source/scale.
deterministic_blocker.impact: The preflight can hash the immutable owned copies while the GPU phase executes the unbound mutable originals. Current bytes match, but the source-identity guarantee requested by this review does not hold.

required_remediation: Make the owned model source authoritative regardless of inherited CWD, for example by enabling Python safe-path mode or changing to a controlled non-shadowing directory and promoting the owned root before import.
After import, reject unless models.__path__ and models.birwkv7_diffusion.__file__ resolve beneath the owned v3 model-source root.
Add a regression using the mutable original root as inherited CWD and require owned origins, then publish a new immutable manifest-bound release.
